dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Ah, just reminiscing... Once you reach my age, kid, you find that remembering the past is more enjoyable than contemplating the future.

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: For instance, these days I keep finding myself thinking back to the way my next-door neighbor, Shuzhi, used to look in the prime of her youth...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Ah, the way I'd crouch behind the window and peek out at her... Sometimes she'd see me... even shot me a smile sometimes...

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Boy, I'll never forget that smile. The dimples on her cheeks... that look in her eyes, like her smile was for me, and me alone...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And? Where did it go from there?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Where did it go? ...What on earth do you mean?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: ...You don't seriously think I... told her the way I felt!?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Wh—What is wrong with you? You honestly think a guy should just... straight up tell a girl how they feel!?

dialogues.speaker: Uncle Liu
dialogues.text: Tut-tut, you kids these days... Where's your sense of shame...
